description: This file contains bundled JavaScript code for the 'imagesLoaded' library version 4.1.0, including an internal event emitter 'EvEmitter' and the main 'ImagesLoaded' class, which detects when images within DOM elements have finished loading. It also defines helper functions and jQuery plugin integration.

classes.name: EvEmitter
classes.description: A simple event emitter class providing methods to register, deregister, and emit events.

classes.name: ImagesLoaded
classes.description: Main class that detects when images within specified DOM elements have finished loading, supporting callbacks and event emission.

classes.name: LoadingImage
classes.description: Represents an individual image being loaded, with methods to check load status and emit progress events.

classes.name: Background
classes.description: Handles background images of DOM elements, inheriting from LoadingImage.

methods.name: EvEmitter.prototype.on
methods.description: Registers an event listener for a specific event.

methods.name: EvEmitter.prototype.emitEvent
methods.description: Emits an event, calling all registered listeners.

methods.name: ImagesLoaded.prototype.getImages
methods.description: Collects all images within the target elements.

methods.name: ImagesLoaded.prototype.check
methods.description: Checks the load status of all images and triggers appropriate events.

methods.name: ImagesLoaded.prototype.progress
methods.description: Handles progress updates for individual images.

methods.name: ImagesLoaded.prototype.complete
methods.description: Finalizes the image load detection, emitting success or failure events.
